summary: ArrayVec::remove(len) on a nonempty vector iterated an empty slice, returned a default value, and decremented the length instead of panicking. The fix accesses targets[0] before shifting elements or decrementing length, causing the required bounds panic. The fix adds tests/arrayvec.rs::ArrayVec_remove_invalid, which expects removing index 1 from a one-element vector to panic.
expected_failure: test did not panic as expected
